name: @kinvara/core-modules
description: EV-30 / OD-292a: the code of SA §SA-2's modules that SD §BE-1 loads in more than one deployable, in src/<module>/, plus the shared NestJS runtime in src/runtime/ (Database/Tx/withAppRw, DatabaseModule, errorClass, the decorator helpers) — T-245; the transactional enqueue in src/jobs/ — T-149. Declared by apps/core and apps/worker. Never declares @nestjs/platform-*: that would put an HTTP adapter into the worker image.
